insights.one_liner: Hospitality management school founded in 1929 with campuses in The Hague and Amsterdam, IND recognised sponsor, ranked among the world's top hospitality schools.

culture.text: About 2,800 students and 250 employees across campuses in The Hague and Amsterdam.
Founded and funded by the hospitality industry in 1929, and keeps close ties with it.
Offers a Bachelor in Hospitality Management, a fast-track bachelor, an MBA and a master's in Leading Hotel Transformation.

open.text: Hotelschool The Hague is an IND recognised visa sponsor.

worth_knowing.text: Says it is ranked among the top hospitality management schools in the world by QS.
